title: Lady Gaga assumes CEO role of Haus Labs
summary: Lady Gaga, whose birth name is Stefani Germanotta, has succeeded Ben Jones at Haus Labs, co-founder and former CEO, who is said to have departed the make-up business in October

title: Henkel upgrades 2026 sales outlook after strong Q3
summary: The Olaplex and Schwarzkopf owner’s sales soared 11% to €5.7bn, helped by hair care, as well as price and volume growth in its consumer business

title: Puig CEO unveils plan to become an €8 billion-plus beauty company by 2032
summary: Puig CEO Jose Manuel Albesa is aiming to exceed €8 billion in annual net revenues and become a top four premium beauty company by 2032. His ‘Vision 2032’ plan includes doubling down on prestige and niche fragrances, a focus on dermocosmetics and building out Charlotte Tilbury

title: Has Estée Lauder Companies met its 2026 social impact and sustainability goals?
summary: Estée Lauder Companies (ELC) has released its Social Impact & Sustainability (SI&S) report for 2026, detailing the brand owner’s performance across environmental, social, and governance. Has ELC been able to meet its lofty targets over the past year?

title: Celebrity hair care is oversaturated, but can Jennifer Lawrence’s mes° breakthrough?
summary: With actress Jennifer Lawrence the latest A-lister to launch a hair care brand, and to mixed reviews, she joins the likes of Beyoncé, Rihanna and Blake Lively in the celebrity beauty space. Cosmetics Business explores why the real challenge facing celebrity hair care brands is differentiation

title: Inspired by skin science. Designed for hair vitality.

title: Activon to exhibit at in-cosmetics Asia 2026, showcasing sustainable ingredients and exosome-based solutions
